list.name: Changes
list.comment:
fix(render): fix Nametags visual rendering
- Fix unreadable font size (scale*50 produced ~1.5px text) - Fix drawRect: use MatrixStack matrix, POSITION_COLOR format, reset GL state after rendering (was breaking subsequent draws) - Remove unsupported §-color codes from rendered text - Replace "Масштаб" slider with "Размер шрифта" (pixel-based) - Render health as colored bar + value next to name - Implement armor bar (setting was unused before) - Compact info line: distance / ping / invisibility - Add null-check for mc.getConnection() before ping lookup - Sort entities far-to-near, skip off-screen tags

task.summary:
Fix NameTagItem interaction logic
- Moved return statement inside the inner if block so ActionResultType is only returned when the target is alive and not on a client world - Changed return value to func_233537_a_(false) since we already verify !isRemote - Added else clause to return PASS when target is not alive or on client world
